ei.title: Calm Focus in an Unexpected Crisis
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: An airplane flew high above the deep blue seas far from any land. Flying the small plane was a student pilot who was sitting alongside an experienced flight instructor. As the student looked out the window, she was filled with wonder and appreciation for the beauty of the world. Her instructor, meanwhile, waited patiently for the right time to start a surprise flight emergency training exercise. When the plane hit a bit of turbulence, the instructor pushed a hidden button. Suddenly, all the monitors inside the plane flashed several times then went out completely! Now the student was in control of an airplane that was flying well, but she had no indication of where she was or where she should go. She did have a map, but no other instruments. She was at a loss and then the plane shook again. When the student began to panic, the instructor said, "Stay calm and steady. You can do it." Calm as ever, the instructor told her student, "Difficult times always happen during flight. The most important thing is to focus on your flight in those situations." Those words encouraged the student to focus on flying the aircraft first. "Thank you, I think I can make it," she said, "As I've been trained, I should search for visual markers." Then, the student carefully flew low enough to see if she could find any ships making their way across the surface of the ocean. Now the instructor and the student could see some ships. Although the ships were far apart, they were all sailing in a line. With the line of ships in view, the student could see the way to home and safety. The student looked at her in relief, who smiled proudly back at her student.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) experienced=노련한, (B) wonder=경이로움, (C) patiently=참을성 있게
det.analysis:
❌ ① novice — wonder — patiently: (A) novice(초보의)는 노련한 교관 experienced와 반대
❌ ② experienced — fear — patiently: (B) fear(두려움)는 세상의 아름다움에 느낀 경이로움 wonder와 다름
✅ ③ experienced — wonder — patiently: 원문 일치. 노련한(experienced) 교관, 경이로움(wonder)으로 가득 찬 학생, 참을성 있게(patiently) 기다린 교관이라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ experienced — wonder — impatiently: (C) impatiently(조급하게)는 참을성 있게 기다린 patiently와 반대
det.tip: an experienced flight instructor(노련한) / filled with wonder(경이로움) / waited patiently(참을성 있게)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) hidden=숨겨진, (B) completely=완전히, (C) control=조종/통제
det.analysis:
❌ ① visible — completely — control: (A) visible(보이는)은 몰래 누른 숨겨진 버튼 hidden과 반대
❌ ② hidden — partly — control: (B) partly(부분적으로)는 모니터가 완전히 꺼진 completely와 다름
❌ ③ hidden — completely — confusion: (C) confusion(혼란)은 비행기를 조종하게 된 control과 다름
✅ ④ hidden — completely — control: 원문 일치. 숨겨진(hidden) 버튼을 눌러 모니터가 완전히(completely) 꺼지고, 학생이 비행기를 조종하게(control) 되었다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: a hidden button(숨겨진) / went out completely(완전히) / in control of an airplane(조종)

questions.passage: An airplane flew high above the deep blue seas far from any land. Flying the small plane was a student pilot who was sitting alongside an experienced flight instructor. As the student looked out the window, she was filled with <u>wonder</u> and appreciation for the beauty of the world. Her instructor, meanwhile, waited patiently for the right time to start a surprise flight emergency training exercise. When the plane hit a bit of turbulence, the instructor pushed a hidden button. Suddenly, all the monitors inside the plane flashed several times then went out completely! Now the student was in control of an airplane that was flying well, but she had no indication of where she was or where she should go. She did have a map, but no other instruments. She was at a loss and then the plane shook again. When the student began to panic, the instructor said, "Stay calm and steady. You can do it." Calm as ever, the instructor told her student, "Difficult times always happen during flight. The most important thing is to focus on your flight in those situations." Those words encouraged the student to focus on flying the aircraft first. "Thank you, I think I can make it," she said, "As I've been trained, I should search for visual markers." Then, the student carefully flew low enough to see if she could find any ships making their way across the surface of the ocean. Now the instructor and the student could see some ships. Although the ships were far apart, they were all sailing in a line. With the line of ships in view, the student could see the way to home and safety. The student looked at her in relief, who smiled proudly back at her student.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 wonder와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

✅ ① amazement: amazement(경탄)는 wonder(경이로움)의 동의어 ←정답
❌ ② boredom: boredom(지루함)은 경이로움과 반대
❌ ③ anger: anger(분노)는 경이로움과 무관한 감정
❌ ④ doubt: doubt(의심)은 감탄과 다른 의미
det.tip: wonder = amazement = awe = 경이로움, 경탄

questions.passage:
(A) She could not find a <u>way</u> to solve the difficult math problem on her own.
(B) With the line of ships in view, the student could see the <u>way</u> to home and safety.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 way의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: way: (A) 문제를 푸는 방법 / (B) 집과 안전으로 가는 길/방향
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 방법 — (B) 길/방향: (A)는 문제를 푸는 '방법', (B)는 집과 안전으로 가는 '길/방향'으로 다의어의 두 의미를 올바르게 연결 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 거리 — (B) 길/방향: (A)의 way는 거리가 아니라 방법
❌ ③ (A) 방법 — (B) 방식: (B)의 way는 추상적 방식이 아니라 구체적 길/방향
❌ ④ (A) 무게 — (B) 습관: 두 의미 모두 문맥과 맞지 않음
det.tip: way: ① 방법 ② 길/방향 ③ 방식 ④ (the way S V) ~하는 방식

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "sudden violent movements of air that cause an aircraft to shake while flying"

det.korean: turbulence=난기류 (비행 중 항공기를 흔들리게 하는 갑작스럽고 심한 공기의 움직임)
det.analysis:
❌ ① instrument: instrument(계기)는 공기의 움직임이 아님
❌ ② appreciation: appreciation(감탄)은 감정으로 난기류와 무관
✅ ③ turbulence: turbulence(난기류)는 비행 중 항공기를 흔드는 갑작스러운 공기의 움직임이라는 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ indication: indication(표시/징후)은 공기의 움직임이 아님
det.tip: turbulence = 난기류. movements of air that make an aircraft shake가 핵심

questions.passage: As the student looked out the window, she was __________ (fill) with wonder and appreciation for the beauty of the world. Her instructor, meanwhile, waited patiently for the right time to start a surprise flight emergency training exercise.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: be filled with(~로 가득 차다)는 수동태이므로 fill을 과거분사 filled로 바꾼다
det.analysis: 'she was ___ with wonder and appreciation'에서 'be filled with(~로 가득 차다)'는 수동태 표현이므로 be동사 was 뒤에 과거분사가 와야 한다. fill → filled
det.tip: be filled with ~ = ~로 가득 차다 (was filled with wonder)

questions.passage: The student carefully flew low enough to see if she could find any ships __________ (make) their way across the surface of the ocean. Now the instructor and the student could see some ships.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 명사 ships를 뒤에서 수식하는 현재분사(-ing)로 바꾼다

det.tip: 명사 + V-ing(현재분사): ships making their way (나아가는 배들)
